ez-gfx-bindings.description: Public EzGfx C ABI generated from ez-gfx-ffi Rust declarations and documentation.

handle.name: EzGfxContext
handle.doc: Opaque packed `u64` context handle; slot+1/generation occupy bits 0-39.

handle.name: EzGfxSurface
handle.doc: Opaque packed `u64` surface handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as a surface.

handle.name: EzGfxFrame
handle.doc: Opaque generation-, kind-, owner-, state-, and frame-serial-validated live frame handle.

handle.name: EzGfxReadbackRequest
handle.doc: Stable process-unique identity for one enqueued readback request.

handle.name: EzGfxShader
handle.doc: Opaque packed `u64` shader handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as a shader.

handle.name: EzGfxCounterBuffer
handle.doc: Opaque packed `u64` one-frame counter-buffer handle; child bits resolve only as indirect commands.

handle.name: EzGfxBuffer
handle.doc: Opaque packed `u64` one-frame buffer handle; child bits resolve only as structured data.

handle.name: EzGfxVertexHeap
handle.doc: Opaque named vertex heap whose owner and generation are validated.

handle.name: EzGfxVertexAllocation
handle.doc: Opaque allocation within a named vertex heap whose owner and generation are validated.

handle.name: EzGfxIndexAllocation
handle.doc: Opaque allocation within the singleton index heap whose owner and generation are validated.

handle.name: EzGfxTexture
handle.doc: Opaque packed `u64` texture handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as a texture.

handle.name: EzGfxRenderTarget
handle.doc: Opaque packed `u64` render-target handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as a render target.

value.name: EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument
value.doc: An argument violates the operation contract.

value.name: EzGfxResult_InvalidContext
value.doc: A context or resource handle is invalid or stale.

value.name: EzGfxResult_NotReady
value.doc: Completion or output is not yet available.

value.name: EzGfxResult_QueueFull
value.doc: Asynchronous scheduling or staging capacity is unavailable.

value.name: EzGfxResult_Cancelled
value.doc: An asynchronous operation was cancelled before completion.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_None
value.doc: Indicates that no texture error occurred.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_InvalidContext
value.doc: Indicates that the context identifier is invalid or stale.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_InvalidArguments
value.doc: Indicates that one or more texture arguments are invalid.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_UnsupportedFormat
value.doc: Indicates that the requested texture format cannot be used.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_OutOfTextureHandles
value.doc: Indicates that no texture identifier slots remain.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_OutOfMemory
value.doc: Indicates that texture allocation exhausted available memory.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_DecodeFailed
value.doc: Indicates that the source image could not be decoded.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_VulkanFailed
value.doc: Indicates that a Vulkan texture request failed.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_WorkerUnavailable
value.doc: Indicates that no texture worker is available to process the request.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_NotFound
value.doc: Indicates that the requested texture could not be found.

enum.name: EzGfxAdapterClass
enum.doc: C ABI adapter classification; discriminants mirror core `AdapterClass`.

enum.name: EzGfxRenderTargetFormat
enum.doc: C ABI render-target storage format; discriminants mirror runtime `Format`.

value.name: EzGfxRenderTargetUsage_Depth
value.doc: Supports depth-rendering output; creation stays unsupported.

value.name: EzGfxRenderTargetUsage_Storage
value.doc: Supports storage access; creation stays unsupported.

value.name: EzGfxRenderTargetUsage_Sampled
value.doc: Supports texture sampling; creation stays unsupported.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_Upload
value.doc: A typed upload state transition; `upload` is valid.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_Diagnostic
value.doc: A diagnostic observation; `record` and `level` are valid.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_ObservationsDropped
value.doc: Bounded observability storage discarded records; `dropped` is valid.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_Readback
value.doc: Completed explicitly requested readback bytes; the `readback_*` fields are valid.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_Snapshot
value.doc: Unrequested persistent presentation snapshot; the `readback_*` fields are valid.

enum.name: EzGfxUploadResourceKind
enum.doc: Resource family carried by an upload event.

value.name: EzGfxUploadStatus_SourceStaged
value.doc: Caller source bytes are no longer needed.

value.name: EzGfxSurfacePlatform_Headless
value.doc: Windowless Vulkan headless surface; no native handles.

enum.name: EzGfxSourceTextureFormat
enum.doc: Source image encoding; values 128 through 255 are application decoders.

value.name: EzGfxSourceTextureFormat_Dds
value.doc: DDS image bytes with a legacy or DX10 header.

value.name: EzGfxSourceTextureFormat_Raw
value.doc: Tightly packed mip bytes in the destination storage format.

struct.name: EzGfxContextDesc
struct.doc: Describes graphics-context creation parameters for the C ABI.

field.name: enable_debug
field.doc: Enables graphics-backend debugging when nonzero.

field.name: enable_validation
field.doc: Enables graphics API validation when nonzero.

field.name: surface_platform
field.doc: Selects the native platform used to create presentation surfaces.

field.name: texture_decode_workers
field.doc: Async texture decode worker threads; zero selects the default topology.

field.name: adapter_count
field.doc: Explicit adapter requests; zero keeps default ranking, one selects by identity.

field.name: adapter
field.doc: Exactly `adapter_count` explicit requests; null if and only if zero.

struct.name: EzGfxAdapterDesc
struct.doc: Explicit adapter request selected by stable identity.

field.name: stable_id
field.doc: Stable 128-bit adapter identity from enumeration.

field.name: allow_software
field.doc: Whether a software-class adapter is acceptable; zero or one.

struct.name: EzGfxAdapterInfo
struct.doc: Enumerated adapter identity with admission diagnostics under one software policy.

field.name: stable_id
field.doc: Stable 128-bit adapter identity from enumeration.

field.name: backend
field.doc: Backend code from `EzGfxBackend`.

field.name: adapter_class
field.doc: Class code from `EzGfxAdapterClass`.

field.name: admitted
field.doc: Whether the adapter passes admission under the queried policy; zero or one.

field.name: software_rejected
field.doc: Whether software policy alone rejects the adapter; zero or one.

field.name: error_count
field.doc: Count of unmet profile requirements; zero when admitted.

struct.name: EzGfxBackendContextDesc
struct.doc: Describes graphics-context creation parameters with an explicit backend selector.

field.name: enable_debug
field.doc: Enables graphics-backend debugging when nonzero.

field.name: enable_validation
field.doc: Enables graphics API validation when nonzero.

field.name: surface_platform
field.doc: Selects the native platform used to create presentation surfaces.

field.name: backend
field.doc: Selects the graphics backend by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: texture_decode_workers
field.doc: Async texture decode worker threads; zero selects the default topology.

field.name: adapter_count
field.doc: Explicit adapter requests; zero keeps default ranking, one selects by identity.

field.name: adapter
field.doc: Exactly `adapter_count` explicit requests; null if and only if zero.

struct.name: EzGfxSurfaceDesc
struct.doc: Describes a native presentation surface and its initial extent.

field.name: window
field.doc: Points to the platform-native window object.

field.name: display
field.doc: Points to the platform-native display or connection object.

field.name: platform
field.doc: Identifies the native window-system platform by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: width
field.doc: Specifies the initial surface width in pixels.

field.name: height
field.doc: Specifies the initial surface height in pixels.

field.name: cache_presented_snapshots
field.doc: Enables caching of presented surface snapshots when nonzero.

struct.name: EzGfxShaderDesc
struct.doc: Describes shader source and stage entry points for resource creation.

field.name: path
field.doc: Points to exactly `path_length` UTF-8 bytes.

field.name: path_length
field.doc: Specifies the nonzero byte length available through `path`.

field.name: vertex_entry
field.doc: Points to exactly `vertex_entry_length` UTF-8 bytes when present.

field.name: vertex_entry_length
field.doc: Specifies the vertex-entry byte length, or zero when absent.

field.name: fragment_entry
field.doc: Points to exactly `fragment_entry_length` UTF-8 bytes when present.

field.name: fragment_entry_length
field.doc: Specifies the fragment-entry byte length, or zero when absent.

field.name: compute_entry
field.doc: Points to exactly `compute_entry_length` UTF-8 bytes when present.

field.name: compute_entry_length
field.doc: Specifies the compute-entry byte length, or zero when absent.

field.name: kind
field.doc: Identifies the shader kind by its C ABI numeric code.

struct.name: EzGfxTextureDesc
struct.doc: Describes texture dimensions, formats, mipmapping, sampling, and labeling.

field.name: source_format
field.doc: Identifies the source texel format by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: destination_format
field.doc: Identifies the GPU destination format by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: width
field.doc: Specifies the base mip level width in pixels.

field.name: height
field.doc: Specifies the base mip level height in pixels.

field.name: mip_count
field.doc: Specifies the number of mip levels in the texture.

field.name: generate_mips
field.doc: Requests automatic mip generation when nonzero.

field.name: min_filter
field.doc: Selects the minification filter by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: mag_filter
field.doc: Selects the magnification filter by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: max_anisotropy
field.doc: Specifies the maximum anisotropic filtering ratio.

field.name: address_mode_u
field.doc: Selects the texture-addressing mode for the U coordinate.

field.name: address_mode_v
field.doc: Selects the texture-addressing mode for the V coordinate.

field.name: address_mode_w
field.doc: Selects the texture-addressing mode for the W coordinate.

field.name: debug_label
field.doc: Points to exactly `debug_label_length` UTF-8 bytes when present.

field.name: debug_label_length
field.doc: Specifies the debug-label byte length, or zero when absent.

struct.name: EzGfxRenderTargetDesc
struct.doc: Describes render-target name, usage, format candidates, and clear value.

field.name: name
field.doc: Points to exactly `name_length` UTF-8 bytes; required, 1..=255 bytes.

field.name: name_length
field.doc: Specifies the target-name byte length.

field.name: usage
field.doc: Selects the access mode by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: relative_scale
field.doc: Scale factor relative to the reference dimensions; finite and positive.

field.name: samples
field.doc: Requested multisample count; one of 1, 2, 4, or 8.

field.name: candidate_formats
field.doc: Points to exactly `candidate_count` format codes; required, 1..=16 entries.

field.name: candidate_count
field.doc: Specifies the candidate format count.

field.name: sampleable
field.doc: Non-zero requires texture-sampling support; must be zero or one.

field.name: use_clear
field.doc: Non-zero stores `clear_color`; must be zero or one.

field.name: clear_color
field.doc: Color clear value read only when `use_clear` is non-zero.

struct.name: EzGfxDecodedTextureMip
struct.doc: Decoded bytes for one custom-decoder mip, retained until the release callback.

field.name: width
field.doc: Mip width in texels.

field.name: height
field.doc: Mip height in texels.

field.name: data
field.doc: Readable bytes retained until the release callback.

field.name: data_size
field.doc: Exact byte length at `data`.

struct.name: EzGfxDecodedTexture
struct.doc: Custom-decoder output copied before its release callback is invoked.

field.name: format
field.doc: Destination-format code; `Auto` is invalid for decoded output.

field.name: mip_count
field.doc: Number of entries at `mips`.

field.name: mips
field.doc: Readable array retained until the release callback.

struct.name: EzGfxTextureRegionDesc
struct.doc: Borrowed bytes and destination rectangle for one asynchronous texture update.

field.name: mip_level
field.doc: Destination mip level.

field.name: x
field.doc: Destination X offset in texels.

field.name: y
field.doc: Destination Y offset in texels.

field.name: width
field.doc: Region width in texels.

field.name: height
field.doc: Region height in texels.

field.name: data
field.doc: Readable tightly packed texel or compressed-block bytes.

field.name: data_size
field.doc: Exact byte length at `data`.

struct.name: EzGfxTextureUploadTelemetry
struct.doc: Monotonic context-wide asynchronous texture pipeline counters.

field.name: decode_microseconds
field.doc: Aggregate CPU decode/transcode/mip-generation time.

field.name: staging_bytes
field.doc: Aggregate bytes admitted to native staging.

field.name: queue_latency_microseconds
field.doc: Aggregate transfer-owner queue latency.

field.name: handoff_latency_microseconds
field.doc: Aggregate transfer-to-graphics handoff latency.

struct.name: EzGfxBinding
struct.doc: Associates a named shader binding with buffer and render-target resources.

field.name: name
field.doc: Points to exactly `name_length` UTF-8 shader-binding-name bytes.

field.name: name_length
field.doc: Specifies the nonzero byte length available through `name`.

field.name: buffer
field.doc: Identifies the buffer assigned to the binding.

field.name: counter_buffer
field.doc: Identifies the counter command buffer assigned to the binding.

field.name: render_target
field.doc: Identifies the render target assigned to the binding.

struct.name: EzGfxDynamicState
struct.doc: Encodes dynamic rasterization, topology, and blending state.

field.name: cull_mode
field.doc: Selects the polygon culling mode by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: front_face
field.doc: Selects which vertex winding is considered front-facing.

field.name: primitive_type
field.doc: Selects the primitive topology by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: blend_mode
field.doc: Selects the color blending mode by its C ABI numeric code.

struct.name: EzGfxDrawIndexedCommand
struct.doc: Encodes one indexed, optionally instanced draw command.

field.name: index_count
field.doc: Specifies the number of indices drawn per instance.

field.name: instance_count
field.doc: Specifies the number of instances to draw.

field.name: first_index
field.doc: Specifies the starting index within the index buffer.

field.name: vertex_offset
field.doc: Specifies the signed offset added to each fetched vertex index.

field.name: first_instance
field.doc: Specifies the first instance identifier used by the draw.

struct.name: EzGfxByteBuffer
struct.doc: Describes a contiguous read-only byte range across the C ABI.

field.name: length
field.doc: Specifies the byte count available through `data`.

field.name: data
field.doc: Points to the first byte of the range and may be null only when `length` is zero.

struct.name: EzGfxHandleParts
struct.doc: Exposes the slot and generation components encoded in an opaque identifier.

field.name: context_slot
field.doc: Identifies the context slot in the context arena.

field.name: context_generation
field.doc: Records the generation of the context slot.

field.name: child_slot
field.doc: Identifies the child-resource slot within the context.

field.name: child_generation
field.doc: Records the generation of the child-resource slot.

field.name: is_context
field.doc: Is nonzero when the identifier refers directly to a context.

field.name: _padding
field.doc: Reserves bytes that keep the C ABI layout stable.

struct.name: EzGfxRuntimeRecord
struct.doc: Records correlated runtime progress for a graphics resource.

field.name: correlation_id
field.doc: Identifies the request or event associated with this record.

field.name: resource
field.doc: Identifies the graphics resource associated with this record.

field.name: backend
field.doc: Identifies the graphics backend by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: phase
field.doc: Identifies the runtime phase by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: status
field.doc: Identifies the phase status by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: _padding
field.doc: Reserves bytes that keep the C ABI layout stable.

struct.name: EzGfxUploadEvent
struct.doc: One lossless typed upload transition.

field.name: resource
field.doc: Opaque texture, vertex-allocation, or index-allocation handle.

field.name: resource_kind
field.doc: Resource kind: 1 texture, 2 vertex allocation, 3 index allocation.

field.name: status
field.doc: Status: 1 source staged, 2 device ready, 3 failed, 4 cancelled.

field.name: error
field.doc: `RuntimeStatus` code for failed events, zero otherwise.

field.name: _padding
field.doc: Reserves bytes that keep the C ABI layout stable.

struct.name: EzGfxDiagnostic
struct.doc: Couples a runtime record with its diagnostic severity.

field.name: record
field.doc: Contains the correlated runtime record being diagnosed.

field.name: level
field.doc: Identifies the diagnostic severity by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: _padding
field.doc: Reserves bytes that keep the C ABI layout stable.

struct.name: EzGfxEvent
struct.doc: One tagged graphics event delivered to the registered context callback. Only the payload selected by `kind` is valid. Readback bytes are borrowed for the callback invocation and must not be retained afterwards.

field.name: kind
field.doc: Selects the valid payload by its C ABI numeric code.

field.name: _pad_kind
field.doc: Reserves bytes that keep the C ABI layout stable.

field.name: upload
field.doc: Upload transition; valid when `kind` is `Upload`.

field.name: record
field.doc: Runtime or diagnostic record; valid when `kind` is `Runtime` or `Diagnostic`.

field.name: level
field.doc: Diagnostic severity; valid when `kind` is `Diagnostic`.

field.name: _pad_level
field.doc: Reserves bytes that keep the C ABI layout stable.

field.name: dropped
field.doc: Discarded-record count; valid when `kind` is `ObservationsDropped`.

field.name: readback_request_id
field.doc: Stable request correlator, or zero for an unrequested snapshot.

field.name: readback_texture
field.doc: Readback source texture, or zero for a surface-presented snapshot.

field.name: readback_width
field.doc: Readback image width in pixels; valid for `Readback` or `Snapshot`.

field.name: readback_height
field.doc: Readback image height in pixels; valid for `Readback` or `Snapshot`.

field.name: readback_byte_count
field.doc: Readback byte count; valid for `Readback` or `Snapshot`.

field.name: readback_bytes
field.doc: Readback RGBA bytes borrowed for this callback invocation only.

callback.name: EzGfxTextureDecoderCallback
callback.doc: Custom image decoder invoked concurrently by texture workers.

callback.name: EzGfxTextureDecoderReleaseCallback
callback.doc: Releases a custom decoder result after ez-gfx copies every mip.

callback.name: EzGfxEventCallback
callback.doc: Context event callback invoked on the owner thread at graphics safe points. `event` borrows its payload, including readback bytes, for the invocation only. `user_data` is the registration value. Callbacks must not reenter graphics operations or unwind; a reentrant dispatch attempt fails and a panic unregisters the callback.

function.name: ez_gfx_adapter_count
function.doc: Returns the number of enumerated adapters without creating anything.

param.name: out_count
param.doc: Receives the number of enumerated adapters.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_adapter_query
function.doc: Enumerates adapters with admission diagnostics under one software policy. A zero capacity queries the total with a null buffer; otherwise the call fills at most `capacity` entries and reports how many it wrote. The `admitted`, `software_rejected`, and `error_count` fields diagnose each rejection without creating anything.

param.name: allow_software
param.doc: Non-zero admits software-class adapters in the diagnosis; zero or one.

param.name: out_adapters
param.doc: Receives at most capacity entries; null if and only if capacity is zero.

param.name: capacity
param.doc: Writable entry count of out_adapters; zero queries the total with a null buffer.

param.name: out_written
param.doc: Receives entries written, or the total when capacity is zero.

function.name: ez_gfx_error_print
function.doc: Writes the stable UTF-8 message for an ABI result code. `out_required` receives the byte count including the trailing NUL. Pass a null buffer with zero capacity to query that count. Insufficient capacity returns `InvalidArgument` without modifying the buffer.

param.name: result
param.doc: Result byte to describe; unknown values produce 'unknown error'.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Caller-owned UTF-8 output; null only for a zero-capacity size query.

param.name: capacity
param.doc: Writable output bytes, or zero for a size query.

param.name: out_required
param.doc: Required bytes including the trailing NUL.

returns.doc: Returns Ok, or InvalidArgument for an invalid pointer/capacity pair or insufficient storage.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_heap_create
function.doc: Creates a named vertex heap and returns its typed handle.

returns.doc: Returns validation, allocation, or native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_heap_destroy
function.doc: Destroys the vertex heap selected by its typed handle.

param.name: context
param.doc: Owning context; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: Stale and foreign handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_index_allocation_create
function.doc: Uploads packed-u32 indices and returns a typed allocation handle.

returns.doc: Returns upload or validation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_heap_upload
function.doc: Uploads elements to a typed vertex heap and returns an allocation handle.

returns.doc: Returns upload, ownership, or validation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_allocation_get_range
function.doc: Queries a live vertex allocation range.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_index_allocation_get_range
function.doc: Queries a live index allocation range.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_allocation_remove
function.doc: Removes a live vertex allocation after establishing GPU safety.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_index_allocation_remove
function.doc: Removes a live index allocation after establishing GPU safety.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_buffer_acquire
function.doc: Acquires a context-owned buffer sized for the requested elements.

returns.doc: Returns validation or allocation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_buffer_write
function.doc: Copies a typed element range into a buffer.

param.name: data
param.doc: Element bytes; null only when count is zero.

returns.doc: Returns validation, ownership, or range status.

function.name: ez_gfx_buffer_release
function.doc: Releases a context-owned buffer handle; zero and stale values are ignored.

param.name: context
param.doc: Owning context; zero and stale values are ignored.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Buffer handle; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: Stale handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_handle_inspect
function.doc: Decodes a packed handle into its context and optional child slot generations.

param.name: out_parts
param.doc: Receives context and optional child slot generations.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a handle validation error.

function.name: ez_gfx_semantic_id
function.doc: Computes the fixed-size identifier for a canonical semantic name.

param.name: name
param.doc: Exact ASCII dot-separated name bytes; each non-empty segment starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits, or underscores; embedded NUL is invalid.

param.name: length
param.doc: Name byte count in the inclusive range 1..255.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_abi_version
function.doc: Returns the C ABI revision supported by this library.

returns.doc: ABI version; no context is required.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_create
function.doc: Creates a graphics context from debug, validation, and surface-platform options.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a creation error.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_create_backend
function.doc: Creates a graphics context for Vulkan, Direct3D 12, or Metal.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation, admission, or native error.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_wait_idle
function.doc: Waits until all work submitted through the graphics context is idle, then delivers pending events.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or an invalid-context, not-ready, native-failure, or device-loss result.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_destroy
function.doc: Destroys the graphics context after aborting every live descendant frame.

param.name: context
param.doc: Context to destroy on its creator thread; zero, stale, repeated, and wrong-thread calls are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; wait or release failures cannot be reported through the stable ABI.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_register_callback
function.doc: Replaces the context event callback and delivers pending events. A null callback clears the registration. Delivery runs on the calling owner thread inside this and other dispatching entry points, never on a worker thread. Callbacks must not reenter dispatching operations and must not unwind; a reentrant call fails and a panic unregisters the callback.

param.name: callback
param.doc: Callback to install; null clears the registration.

param.name: user_data
param.doc: Application state borrowed only during callback invocation.

returns.doc: Returns context, callback, or dispatch status.

function.name: ez_gfx_shader_load_artifact
function.doc: Loads every stage from a compiler-produced shader artifact; no source compiler is linked into this runtime.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or validation/native failure.

function.name: ez_gfx_shader_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a shader previously loaded into the context.

param.name: context
param.doc: Owning context; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; stale handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_begin
function.doc: Begins one surface frame and returns its explicit owner handle.

returns.doc: Returns readiness or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_acquire
function.doc: Acquires a context-owned one-frame counter buffer with a runtime element stride.

returns.doc: Returns validation or allocation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_write_draws
function.doc: Writes a contiguous indexed-draw command batch.

param.name: commands
param.doc: Contiguous command data; null only when count is zero.

returns.doc: Returns ownership, overflow, or bounds status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_publish_count
function.doc: Publishes a CPU-known count for compute-generated indirect commands.

returns.doc: Returns ownership or bounds status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_release
function.doc: Releases an unconsumed counter buffer.

param.name: context
param.doc: Owning context; zero and stale values are ignored.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Counter buffer; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; stale and zero handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_add_vertex_pipeline
function.doc: Records an indexed graphics pipeline operation with bindings, dynamic state, and push constants.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Counter buffer consumed by this frame for indirect commands.

returns.doc: Returns validation or native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_add_compute_pipeline
function.doc: Records a compute dispatch with its shader, bindings, dimensions, and push constants.

returns.doc: Returns validation or native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_enqueue_texture_readback
function.doc: Enqueues a texture readback and returns its stable callback correlator.

returns.doc: Returns frame, handle, or output-pointer status.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_end
function.doc: Consumes and completes a frame; every result invalidates the handle. Queued upload, runtime, and diagnostic events dispatch before ordered requested readbacks. Persistent presentation captures are trailing `Snapshot` events with request ID zero.

returns.doc: Returns submission or presentation status; every result invalidates the handle.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_abort
function.doc: Consumes a frame without submitting; every result invalidates the handle.

returns.doc: Returns abort status; every result invalidates the handle.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_create
function.doc: Creates a Win32, GLFW, or Metal-layer presentation surface and returns its handle.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation/native error.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_init_device
function.doc: Initializes the context device for the specified presentation surface.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a native failure.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_resize
function.doc: Requests new pixel dimensions for a presentation surface.

param.name: width
param.doc: New width; zero is valid only with zero height for minimized state.

param.name: height
param.doc: New height; zero is valid only with zero width for minimized state.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok, EzGfxResult_NotReady, or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_get_extent
function.doc: Queries the current width and height of a presentation surface.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_NotReady while minimized.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_resize_pending
function.doc: Reports whether a presentation-surface resize remains pending.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_set_snapshot_cache
function.doc: Enables or disables caching of presented snapshots for a surface.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation error.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a presentation surface owned by the context.

param.name: context
param.doc: Owning context; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; null handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_create
function.doc: Creates a managed render target from a declaration and explicit extents. Depth, storage, and sampled-only declarations stay unsupported with explicit errors; multisampled color declarations allocate render storage that resolves into the sampled image. The target leases one heap slot from the

param.name: desc
param.doc: Target name, usage, candidates, and clear value.

returns.doc: Returns Ok, Unsupported for depth/storage/multisample, or validation/native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a render target and clears any bound override; stale handles are ignored.

param.name: context
param.doc: Owning context; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; null or stale handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_get_format
function.doc: Reports the resolved storage format code of a live render target.

param.name: out_format
param.doc: Receives the format code from EzGfxRenderTargetFormat.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_get_extent
function.doc: Reports the extents of a live render target.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_get_clear
function.doc: Reports the stored clear value of a live render target. Writes one zero-or-one flag plus four color components (`[0, 0, 0, 0]` when no clear is stored).

param.name: out_color
param.doc: Receives four color components; zeros when no clear is stored.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_probe_format
function.doc: Probes whether one format admits a sampled color target at the given sample count. The status is the answer: `Ok` when resolvable, `Unsupported` otherwise. Depth, storage, and above-ceiling sample requests stay unsupported with explicit errors.

param.name: samples
param.doc: Requested multisample count; one of 1, 2, 4, or 8.

returns.doc: Returns Ok when resolvable, Unsupported otherwise, or validation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_frame_begin
function.doc: Begins one render-target frame and returns its explicit owner handle.

returns.doc: Returns state, handle, or capability status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_decoder_register
function.doc: Registers one application decoder for a custom source code in `128..=255`. The callback may run concurrently. Successful output is copied and then released exactly once.

param.name: user_data
param.doc: Application state retained through unregister and accepted work.

returns.doc: Returns Ok or InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_decoder_unregister
function.doc: Unregisters one custom source decoder. Accepted requests retain their callback.

returns.doc: Returns Ok or InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_load
function.doc: Loads texture bytes, configures sampling and mip residency, and returns a texture handle.

returns.doc: Returns queueing, validation, decode, or support status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_cancel
function.doc: Cancels a texture request before native transfer submission.

returns.doc: Returns Ok when cancellation wins, or InvalidArgument for a terminal or stale request.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_get_binding
function.doc: Queries the binding index assigned to a loaded texture.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_NotReady while upload remains in flight.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_get_residency
function.doc: Queries the resident and total mip counts for a loaded texture.

param.name: out_resident_mips
param.doc: Receives completed mip count, possibly zero while uploads are pending.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_set_residency
function.doc: Sets the contiguous coarse mip count exposed through the stable texture binding.

returns.doc: Returns Ok when published, NotReady while uploads or safe descriptor rewrites remain pending, or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_update_region
function.doc: Copies and asynchronously uploads one validated texture sub-rectangle.

returns.doc: Returns Ok on admission, QueueFull when scheduling or staging capacity is unavailable, or validation/native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_get_upload_telemetry
function.doc: Returns a snapshot of monotonic context-wide texture upload counters.

returns.doc: Returns Ok or context/device status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_unload
function.doc: Unloads a texture from the context.

param.name: context
param.doc: Owning context; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; null or stale handles are ignored.
